_howto: Order of players in the example lineout (front to back) and what each number does. [HANNAH: swap in our usual setup if you want]
note: One example setup. On the Phins, jumpers and lifters rotate. Flexibility over labels.

roles.1: Front lifter in this example. Lift on the thighs/shorts, hold, and bring the jumper down safely.
roles.2: You throw. Straight down the middle, to the target the call gives you.
roles.3: Lifter in this example. You can lift the jumper in front of you or behind you.
roles.4: Front jumper in this example. On the Phins you might lift instead.
roles.5: The jumper being lifted in this example. Catch or tap the ball down to the 9.
roles.6: Toward the back in this example. Ready to jump, lift, or peel depending on the call.
roles.7: Tail of the lineout in this example. Ready to defend or peel.
roles.8: Back lifter in this example, lifting the 5.
roles.9: Receiver. Wait just off the lineout for the ball from the jumper or the back of a maul.
roles.backs: Backs stand 10 meters back from the lineout until it's over.
